testSolutionWithoutConfirmedAiMatch.title: Segment 103 is a Data Section 3 companion segment usable in any Data Section 3 field slot.
Segment 103 is required per the resolved applicability matrix (see R-024).
Field order matches Section 12.4 (Segment Type, Segment Length, Clerk ID, Voucher ID, WIC Discount Amount, WIC Product Data, EBT Program Data).
Request serialization: every Segment 103 field is separated by a Field Separator, including empty fields.
Response serialization: there is no Field Separator between Segment 103 fields.
WIC Discount Amount maximum length is 40 bytes, composed of one or more 20-byte positional blocks.
WIC Product Data is bounded to 3,001 bytes and begins with a 4-digit Total Length subelement with maximum value 2997.
Segment 103 appears exactly once per message.
eWIC does not support Return transactions (absolute prohibition, not a code lookup).
eWIC operations use a recognized prompt-code set (3086, S086, E086, 0086, 8086) carried in the companion Segment 100 Prompt Code.

Segment 103 applicability matrix: REQUIRED for Food Stamp Electronic Voucher and eWIC Purchase Completion/Voucher Clear; OPTIONAL for all other listed EBT/eWIC transaction types; PROHIBITED for eWIC Return.
